title: EventExtraction v1
description: The result of reading one chapter and proposing story facts. Every array may be empty: a chapter with no discoverable event is a legitimate reading, and an empty result is what a chapter of pure description produces. Nothing here is a decision. Every fact is proposed at status 'candidate' and the status field is deliberately absent, so a model cannot propose its own approval. The importer writes these rows only after this document validates, and a document that fails validation writes nothing at all.

schemaVersion.description: The contract revision. A consumer refuses a version it does not know rather than guessing, because a field whose meaning changed would otherwise be read with the old meaning.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing what happens in the chapter. Recorded for the user's review, never parsed: it is a label on the proposal, not an instruction.

entities.description: People, places, things and named relations the chapter introduces or refers to.

events.description: Things that happen in the chapter, in the order they are narrated.

relations.description: How the entities relate, as established by this chapter.

ref.description: A reference to an entity proposed in the same document. It is a local key rather than a database identifier, because the model cannot know an identifier the repository has not minted yet. The service resolves each key to the id it generated and refuses a document that names a key nothing defines.

type.description: One of the eight kinds the schema stores. The list is the CHECK constraint in migration 000014 and the EntityTypes list in internal/domain/story, so a value accepted here is a value the database accepts.

canonicalName.description: The name the graph should prefer.

aliases.description: Other names the chapter uses for the same entity. The database stores each as a row, so the field is an array rather than a joined string.

name.description: A short label for the event, such as 'Mira finds the letter'. This is story_events.name.

storyTimeOrder.description: The event's position in story time, which is not reading order. A flashback is narrated late and happens early. Null when the chapter does not say, and null is meaningful: it means unknown rather than zero.

locationRef.description: The ref of a location entity in this document, or null.

importance.description: How much the event matters to the story. Empty is allowed and is the common case: a model asked to rate everything rates everything average.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence, 0 to 1. It is recorded for the user's review and never used to auto-accept: PRD FR-030 keeps a human or rule gate in front of every candidate.

role.description: The role the entity held in the event. The list is the schema's CHECK.

relationType.description: The schema's CHECK list. 'other' is the escape hatch and is not a substitute for a value that exists.

validFromEventRef.description: The event from which the relation holds, or null when the chapter does not bound it.
